online-notepad.quickAnswer: Notes Maker is a clean online notepad with zero friction. Create unlimited notes, write with live word and character counts, and every keystroke auto-saves to your browser. Export any note as a Markdown file, or print it cleanly on A4 — or save it as PDF from the print dialog. No account, no signup, and your notes never leave your device.
online-notepad.tagline: Just type — your notes save themselves.
online-notepad.workedExample: You press 'New note', title it 'Grocery list', and type 8 lines: 'Milk 2 litres' through 'Rice 5kg'. The word count reads 24 words, 148 characters. Each keystroke updated the note's timestamp in local storage, so closing the tab loses nothing. Pressing 'Export Markdown' downloads 'grocery-list.md' containing '# Grocery list' followed by your 8 lines. Pressing 'Print note' shows only the note — title, date, and body — ready for A4.
